name: Window Swap
description: Open a window somewhere in the world — views from strangers' homes, submitted by people everywhere.

name: The Useless Web
description: A one-button router into the internet's strangest corners. The classic starting point for a pointless adventure.

name: Neal.fun
description: Spend Bill Gates' money, scale the Space Elevator, dive the Deep Sea — a shelf of the web's best interactive toys.

name: A Soft Murmur
description: Mix rain, thunder, waves, fires and coffee shops into a background ambience for working or drifting off.

name: Radio Garden
description: Spin a glowing globe and drop in on live radio stations from almost every town on Earth.

name: Pointer Pointer
description: Move your mouse anywhere and a photo of someone pointing at exactly that spot appears. Pointless, perfect.

name: Zoomquilt
description: An endlessly zooming collaborative painting — keep going deeper and the scene never stops unfolding.

name: Music for Programming
description: Hour-long, carefully sequenced mixes designed to sit behind long stretches of focused work.

name: Httpster
description: A curated showcase of simply beautiful websites — proof that great design is not the same as heavy design.
